metas.title: Hammer Candle Explained: A Real Bitcoin Example
metas.text: This one candle can warn you that a fall may be ending. Traders call it the hammer. It has a small body near the top. Its lower wick is long, at least 2 times the body. That wick means sellers pushed the price down hard. But buyers pushed it back up before the candle closed. So the buyers won this battle. A hammer matters most at the end of a downtrend. Here is a real Bitcoin candle from September 28. It fell to 82,562 dollars. Then it closed at 83,068 dollars. Small body on top, long lower wick: a real hammer. 5 candles later, Bitcoin was 1 percent higher. Wait for the next candle to close higher. That is confirmation. Put your stop loss just below the wick. A hammer is a clue, never a promise. Watch live whale moves for free on MarketRadar Whale.

metas.title: Shooting Star Candle Pattern Explained: A Real Bitcoin Example
metas.text: This pattern can warn you that a rise may be ending. Traders call it the shooting star. It shows up after prices rose for a while. It has a small body near the bottom. Its upper wick is long, at least 2 times the body. Buyers pushed up, but sellers pushed it back down. Here is a real Bitcoin chart from May 6. It reached 82,799 dollars. Then it closed at 81,401 dollars. This is a real shooting star. 5 days later, Bitcoin was 0.4 percent higher. Wait for the next candle to confirm it. Put your stop loss just above the high. A shooting star is a clue, never a promise. Watch live whale moves for free on MarketRadar Whale.

metas.title: Doji Candle Pattern Explained: A Real Bitcoin Example
metas.text: This pattern can warn you that a fall may be ending. Traders call it the doji. It shows up after prices fell for a while. The open and the close are almost the same. So the body is a thin line, with wicks on both sides. Buyers and sellers ended the fight in a draw. Here is a real Bitcoin chart from September 30. It dipped to 82,914 dollars. Then it closed at 83,607 dollars. This is a real doji. 5 days later, Bitcoin was 2.5 percent higher. Wait for the next candle to confirm it. Put your stop loss just below the low. A doji is a clue, never a promise. Watch live whale moves for free on MarketRadar Whale.
